public.edit_promo(uuid,text,jsonb,uuid[]),"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edit_promo(p_id uuid, p_expected_version text, p_values jsonb, p_item_ids uuid[])
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare existing public.promos%rowtype
item_ids uuid[]
fields constant text[]:=array['name','promo_type','suggest','min_subtotal','min_qty','max_qty','kelipatan','auto_apply','discount_type','discount_value','branch_ids','valid_from','valid_until']
begin
perform public.assert_promo_manager()
select * into existing from public.promos where id=p_id for update
if not found then raise exception 'Promo tidak ditemukan atau tidak dapat diakses' using errcode='42501'
snapshot:=public.promo_edit_snapshot(p_id)
if p_expected_version is null or snapshot->>'version' is distinct from p_expected_version then
raise exception 'PROMO_EDIT_CONFLICT: Promo sudah berubah. Muat ulang data terbaru sebelum mengedit lagi.' using errcode='40001'
end if
if jsonb_typeof(p_values) is distinct from 'object' or not p_values ?& fields
or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_values) k where k<>all(fields)) then raise exception 'Data edit promo tidak lengkap atau memuat kolom yang tidak diizinkan'
if jsonb_typeof(p_values->'name')<>'string' or jsonb_typeof(p_values->'suggest')<>'string'
or length(btrim(p_values->>'name')) not between 1 and 120 or nullif(btrim(p_values->>'suggest'),'') is null then raise exception 'Nama (maks. 120 karakter) & teks saran wajib diisi'
if p_values->>'promo_type' not in('diskon_produk','bundling','tebus_murah') or p_values->>'promo_type' is null then raise exception 'Tipe promo tidak valid'
if p_values->>'discount_type' is not null and p_values->>'discount_type' not in('percent','nominal') then raise exception 'Jenis diskon tidak valid'
if jsonb_typeof(p_values->'kelipatan')<>'boolean' or jsonb_typeof(p_values->'auto_apply')<>'boolean' then raise exception 'Aturan otomatis/kelipatan tidak valid'
foreach key in array array['min_qty','max_qty','discount_value','min_subtotal'] loop
if jsonb_typeof(p_values->key) not in('null','number') then raise exception 'Angka promo tidak valid'
number_value:=(p_values->>key)::numeric
if number_value::text in('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') then raise exception 'Angka promo tidak valid'
end loop
values_row:=jsonb_populate_record(null::public.promos,p_values-array['suggest','min_subtotal'])
min_subtotal:=(p_values->>'min_subtotal')::numeric
if min_subtotal<0 then raise exception 'Min. subtotal tidak boleh negatif'
if values_row.discount_type is not null and (values_row.discount_value is null or values_row.discount_value<=0) then raise exception 'Nilai diskon harus lebih dari 0'
if values_row.discount_type='percent' and values_row.discount_value>100 then raise exception 'Diskon persen tidak boleh lebih dari 100%%'
if values_row.min_qty<=0 then raise exception 'Min. qty harus lebih dari 0'
if values_row.max_qty<=0 then raise exception 'Maks. qty harus lebih dari 0'
if values_row.max_qty<values_row.min_qty then raise exception 'Maks. qty tidak boleh lebih kecil dari min. qty'
if values_row.valid_until<values_row.valid_from then raise exception 'Tanggal berakhir lebih awal dari tanggal mulai'
if values_row.auto_apply and (values_row.discount_type is null or values_row.discount_value is null) then raise exception 'Potong otomatis butuh jenis & nilai diskon terisi'
if values_row.auto_apply and values_row.kelipatan and values_row.min_qty is null then raise exception 'Aturan kelipatan butuh min. qty terisi'
if p_item_ids is null or array_position(p_item_ids,null) is not null then raise exception 'Daftar barang promo tidak valid'
select coalesce(array_agg(distinct id order by id),'{}') into item_ids from unnest(p_item_ids) id
if jsonb_typeof(p_values->'branch_ids') not in('array','null') then raise exception 'Daftar cabang promo tidak valid'
new_branch_ids:=values_row.branch_ids
if array_position(new_branch_ids,null) is not null then raise exception 'Daftar cabang promo tidak valid'
select array_agg(distinct id order by id) into new_branch_ids from unnest(new_branch_ids) id
-- An unchanged legacy/inactive target can be retained. Only NEW targets must be active.
-- Lock referenced catalog rows through commit against concurrent archive/delete.
perform id from public.items where id=any(item_ids) order by id for share
if exists(select 1 from unnest(item_ids) candidate(id) where not exists(select 1 from public.promo_items where promo_id=p_id and item_id=candidate.id)
and not exists(select 1 from public.items i where i.id=candidate.id and i.is_active)) then raise exception 'Barang baru harus tersedia dan aktif
perform id from public.branches where id=any(new_branch_ids) order by id for share
if exists(select 1 from unnest(new_branch_ids) candidate(id) where not(candidate.id=any(coalesce(existing.branch_ids,'{}')))
and not exists(select 1 from public.branches b where b.id=candidate.id and b.is_active and public.user_can_access_branch(b.id))) then raise exception 'Cabang baru harus tersedia dan aktif
new_rule:=coalesce(existing.rule,'{}')-'suggest'-'min_subtotal'
new_rule:=new_rule||jsonb_build_object('suggest',btrim(p_values->>'suggest'))
if min_subtotal is not null then new_rule:=new_rule||jsonb_build_object('min_subtotal',min_subtotal)
update public.promos set name=btrim(values_row.name),promo_type=values_row.promo_type,rule=new_rule,
min_qty=values_row.min_qty,max_qty=values_row.max_qty,kelipatan=values_row.kelipatan,auto_apply=values_row.auto_apply,
discount_type=values_row.discount_type,discount_value=values_row.discount_value,
branch_ids=new_branch_ids,valid_from=values_row.valid_from,valid_until=values_row.valid_until where id=p_id
delete from public.promo_items where promo_id=p_id and not(item_id=any(item_ids))

insert into public.promo_items(promo_id,item_id) select p_id,candidate.id from unnest(item_ids) candidate(id) where not exists(select 1 from public.promo_items i where i.promo_id=p_id and i.item_id=candidate.id)
return public.promo_edit_snapshot(p_id)
end$function$
